title: PageSpec
description: A page composition. `mode` is required: "clone" = faithful reconstruction of the source (real brand, copy and assets may be reused for fidelity); "generation" = a new page for someone else, which must contain nothing that identifies or reproduces the source (enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py GENERATION_MODE_* rules). Styling is owned by section/component contracts; the optional node `style` may only name approved tokens from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json (TOKEN_* rules).

mode.description: clone = source reconstruction; generation = new page with zero source identity or content.

theme.description: Theme id; must be one of registry.manifest.json schemaValidatedThemes (TOKEN_THEME_UNSUPPORTED).

brand.description: Generation mode: the fictional / operator brand the page is for. Checked against the source identity like any other text.

style.description: Optional per-node token choices. Values are token ids from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json, never raw values.
